analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($545.18) vs SMA5/20/50 ($537.70/$531.61/$517.28): Above short/mid-term trends, indicating bullish position.
· High position relative to SMA100/200 ($473.63/$439.26): Maintaining long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (93.3%) + Approaching historical high levels.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (40.1→57.5) + Confirmed exit from oversold territory + Strengthening upward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-3.4594→0.2092) + Improvement confirmed + Bullish trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Near middle band $531.61) + Bandwidth at 7.48%, indicating normal levels.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($517.55) + Support confirmed based on SMA50.
· Swing Resistance ($551.15) + Potential for further upside upon breakout.
· 5-day High ($559.15) / 20-day High ($559.15) vs Current Price, Higher Low pattern confirmed with 5-day low ($507.82) > 20-day low ($504.96).
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.72x) + Lower volume compared to previous average, potential for weakening upward momentum.
· Current Stage Diagnosis: Uptrend continuation, buy entry conditions met after 5 consecutive volatile sessions.
